title: Night meeting with Puthoff and Hameroff about microtubules

tellings.quote: it was wild actually last night I was in a room with him and Stuart Hamarov who is you know obviously you know responsible for this orchestrated objective reduction quantum consciousness

plain: In 2026, Michels says, he spent an evening in a room with the scientist Hal Puthoff and Stuart Hameroff, talking about microtubules, the tiny tube-shaped structures inside cells. Michels tells this himself, as something that happened "last night." He describes Hameroff as the man responsible for "orchestrated objective reduction," a theory that consciousness comes from quantum effects inside those microtubules.
